standard_prerequisites: Context span 4517-4604: F(X) = product over pairs of distinct points with x' leading to x of Z/2Z, the contravariant F(f), sheafification G; the three verifications - G(X) != 0 when a nontrivial specialization exists (generalizations lift along flat morphisms, Morphisms lemma-generalizations-lift-flat), G(X) = 0 when no specializations (fields and more generally rings with all primes maximal), G(X) = G(X') for thickenings (topological invariance of the etale site, Etale Cohomology theorem-topological-invariance); the variant F_n on |X|^{n+1} with sheafification G_n
core_obligations: G_n is zero on schemes of dimension < n: no chain of n specializations exists, so F_n and all its etale fibres vanish, hence the sheafification vanishes

G_n is nonzero on schemes of dimension >= n: pick a chain x_n leads to ... leads to x_0 of length n and an element a nonzero at (x_0, ..., x_n); the same generalizations-lift argument as for G shows a survives sheafification
Thickenings leave G_n invariant: F_n(U) = F_n(U') for U' -> X' etale and U = U' x_{X'} X since the topological space is unchanged, so G_n(X) = G_n(X')
proof_roadmap: Vanishing below n from the absence of specialization chains
Nonvanishing from dimension n via the generalizations-lift argument as in the context
Thickening invariance from topological invariance of the etale site
